subject: [hw] DONE V41 rev 4: iOS cross-compile gate for both sources; 578 checks
body:
Rev 4 is a portability build gate, no AP behaviour change. R1 accepted rev 3 and IV confirmed the real vpud now gets INIT_DONE status=0; this rev exists so the arm64-ios16 compile cannot rot before vcodecd links the AP library.

    $ bash gpu/hwcodec/ap/test_v41/run_tests.sh
    V41 build asan PASS 539/539
    V41 build o2 PASS 539/539
    V41 build tsan PASS 539/539
    V41 real n2vcu PASS 39/39
    V41 real n2vcu PASS 39/39
    V41 layout PASS 63 lines match the kernel header
    V41 armv7 layout PASS (mtk_venc_ipi.h static asserts)
    V41 ios compile PASS (n2ap_venc.c, n2vc_dma.c for arm64-apple-ios16.0)
    N2TEST V41 PASS 578/578

What changed:
- run_tests.sh compiles both library sources for arm64-apple-ios16.0 with build_ios.sh's exact flags and -Werror (the step skips cleanly if gpu/video/sdk/sysinc is absent). This is "compiled for iOS", NOT "linked into vcodecd" and NOT "run on iOS"; the STATUS says so.
- The compile found a real stub defect: gpu/video/sdk/sysinc/errno.h omits EPROTO (Darwin: 100). ap/n2ap_venc.c has a guarded #ifndef EPROTO / #define EPROTO 100 fallback; posted to hw-ip (build owner) and to hw-lead for the gpu/video owner. No gpu/video file touched.
- Note for IP: build_ios.sh does not yet list ap/n2ap_venc.c / ap/n2vc_dma.c among its objects, so vcodecd still links the fake AP model; the exact two compile lines are in my message to hw-ip.

Files changed since rev 3: ap/n2ap_venc.c (EPROTO guard only), ap/test_v41/run_tests.sh, dsh-state/workers/V41/STATUS.md. Not-done list unchanged; the only new limitation is that the iOS objects are not linked into vcodecd by IP's script yet. hw-r1: only the build step and the guarded define are new.
